reviews.text: Since adopting my dog, I've taken him here for checkups, vaccinations, and deworming, and they always treat him very well and he feels comfortable with them. I highly recommend it!

We took our small dog Truffles, who had injured her eye.  Dr Roberto was very friendly and took amazing care of her.  He explained the injury, said it wasn’t anything to worry about and put some drops in her eye. Never tried to sell us any products or addition exams.   I highly recommend this place. 5 Stars !
The burgers are spectacular. They're amazing!
Good service and good prices at the dog grooming salon
I take my boxer and my beagle to their monthly bath and they return them to me smelling delicious.

Dr. Roberto is the best doctor!!! He was so kind and careful with my kitten. My kitten had a 30-day course of injections and would only let Dr. Roberto give him the injections. He genuinely cares about his well-being. It was such a relief to find this place, and I highly recommend it. Excellent administration and the doctor's wonderful character. Thank you so much! 🥺🧡 Blessings

I want to share my terrible experience at this place. I took my one-and-a-half-year-old dog to the hotel for four days and three nights. I asked them to send me photos and videos of her, but they didn't. They told me she was doing great and getting along well with the other dogs (this was on Friday, the day I dropped her off). They didn't tell me anything else the following days. On Sunday, I sent a message to ask how my dog ​​was, and they told me she had bitten the doctor and tried to bite another dog, only letting her companions handle her one at a time. I found this very strange because she's not usually like that. Today, when we went to pick her up, the "doctor" rudely said they wouldn't accept her again and that he even had to bathe her because she was covered in her own pee and poop, which is also strange because she never does that. They probably had her locked in a cage or something, and she got stressed because she obviously isn't used to being in a cage. It's good that they told me they won't accept her again because, anyway, I'm not going to let her go back. I was going to take her there again. A lesson for me is to read the comments here because if I had read them before, I wouldn't have left her there. That's why I wanted to share this here, because it's a place that should be closed.

I read some really bad reviews years ago... but I've been going there for a year now to get my babies' nails trimmed, and the vet is always super friendly and very careful. He's the only one they let trim their nails with, and he doesn't grab them roughly like he does at other places. I always see him treating other pets well too.
They always give Patch a super clean bath. And their appointment system is very efficient!
Always great service for my dog.
They're always so kind, and my dog ​​always leaves happy. Thank you for taking care of Waffle and now Haru!
